name: Colorbox Field Formatter
description: A field formatter for various field types like text, computed, entity reference or image to format those field in display styles or views as links to a colorbox.
project_description:
This modules provides a field formatter, so that you can easily activate the colorbox for fields that are part of a display type or a view. The following field types are currently supported:

 
 Text (part of Drupal core) 
 Images (part of Drupal core) 
 Computed Fields 
 Entity References 
 
 Dependencies 
 Colorbox - https://www.drupal.org/project/colorbox 

 Recommended modules 
 
 Colorbox Inline 
 Colorbox Load 
 Colorbox Node
